name: What are common signs of a broken water line?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a broken water line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several indicators suggest a broken water line. You might notice unusually high water bills without a change in usage, which often points to a hidden leak. Puddles or consistently wet spots in your yard, especially when it hasn't rained, can indicate a subsurface leak. A sudden drop in water pressure throughout your home, or the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use, also warrant investigation. Discolored water or a persistent musty odor might also be signs of a problem requiring professional assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include high water bills, wet spots in your yard, low water pressure, discolored water, or the sound of running water when off.
